info.title: Tikkit API
info.description: Conventions: docs/api-conventions.md. Errors use the ErrorEnvelope schema; lists use `limit`/`cursor` and return a Page. Authentication is the HttpOnly `tikkit_session` cookie; every POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE must send `X-Requested-With: tikkit` or is rejected with 403 `csrf_rejected` (docs/auth.md).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, 1-100 (default 25). Out-of-range values are clamped.

post.summary:
Deactivates an account (Admin only): login is refused and all its sessions
end immediately. Tickets and audit history are kept. The last active Admin
cannot be deactivated.

Signs in with username and password. Every failure is the same
`invalid_credentials`, whether the account is unknown, deactivated, or the password wrong.

200.description: Signed in; a new session cookie is set

post.summary: Revokes the current session and clears the cookie. Idempotent.

patch.summary: Updates the signed-in account's email and/or language.

post.summary: Changes the password, revokes every session of this account, and issues a fresh one.

204.description: Password changed; new session cookie set

post.summary:
Starts password recovery for a username. Always `202` with no body, whether
or not the account exists, so the response reveals nothing. An active
account gets a one-hour, single-use link at its stored email when SMTP is configured.

Sets a new password with a recovery token, invalidates every other recovery
token of the account, and revokes all its sessions. Sign in afterwards.

get.summary: Liveness: the process is serving. Touches no dependencies.
Invitations newest first, optionally including all historical statuses (Admin only).

parameters.name: include_history
parameters.description: Include accepted/expired/revoked invitations. Default false preserves the pending-only view.

post.summary:
Creates a single-use invitation (Admin only). The role is fixed here and
applied on acceptance; the invitee cannot change it.

Creates the invited account with the invitation's role and signs it in.
The invitation is consumed only when this commits; validation errors and
username collisions leave it usable. Concurrent acceptance has one winner.

Checks an invitation token without consuming it. The token travels in the
body, never in the URL, so it stays out of request logs.
Reissue replaces an unused invitation atomically; concurrent/replayed requests fail.

Revokes a pending invitation (Admin only). Used or already revoked
invitations are `not_found`.

get.summary:
Readiness: the database answers and its schema matches this build.
Reports stable check identifiers only, never connection details.

503.description: A required dependency is unavailable or incompatible

get.summary: The saved outbound connection, or `connection: null` (Admin only).

put.summary:
Creates or replaces the outbound connection (Admin only).
A missing `password` keeps the stored one. The response never contains it.

delete.summary: Removes the outbound connection (Admin only). Later mail is not sent.

post.summary:
Sends a test message through the saved connection (Admin only).
The recipient must be this Admin's email or the configured sender address.
Transport security is the saved STARTTLS or implicit TLS setting; it is not
taken from the request. Failures use stable codes and do not echo credentials.

get.summary: Whether first-admin setup is still open.

post.summary: Creates the first Admin and signs them in. Works exactly once per deployment.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, 1-100 (default 25). Out-of-range values are clamped.

email.description: Contact address only; never identifies an account.
Optional recipient. With SMTP configured the link is emailed there.

oneOf.description: Language of the email and preselected account language. Default `en`.
Role of the account created from this invitation. Default `user`.

emailed.description: Whether an email was queued (SMTP configured and an email given).

url.description: Single-use acceptance link. Shown only now; only its hash is stored.

message.description: Safe English fallback text; translate by `code` instead of showing this.

ErrorCode.description: Stable machine-readable error codes. Never translated; clients map them to text.

fields.description: Invalid input fields (dotted paths) and their stable error codes.

request_id.description: Same value as the `x-request-id` response header.

InvitationPreview.description: What an invitee sees before accepting. Opening a link never consumes it.

Language.description: Machine identifiers published in the contract; display text is localized by clients.

allow_reopening.description: Human-closed tickets only. AI-solved records remain permanently non-reopenable.

requester_cancellation_policy.description: Before work starts uses the first human work-start event, never current assignment. Every cancellation requires a reason.

resolution_confirmation_hours.description: Positive elapsed hours, default 168. Future proposals snapshot this policy; timeout closure is not requester acceptance.

timezone.description: UTC or an IANA area/timezone name supported by PostgreSQL; timestamps remain UTC.

Page_AccountSummary.description: One page of a list. `next_cursor` is null on the last page.

Page_Invitation.description: One page of a list. `next_cursor` is null on the last page.

Page_Team.description: One page of a list. `next_cursor` is null on the last page.

Page_TicketAssignmentView.description: One page of a list. `next_cursor` is null on the last page.

items.description:
Public handling details shown to a ticket's requester. `team_name: null`
means the shared general queue; `assignee_display_name: null` means unassigned.

SmtpConnection.description: Masked connection. The password is never included.

last_delivery_error.description: Stable code from the last background delivery failure, if any.

password_set.description: Always true when a connection exists. The value itself is not returned.

SmtpSecurity.description:
How the relay expects the connection to be encrypted. There is no plaintext
or opportunistic mode: certificate verification stays on.

password.description: Required when creating the connection. Omit to keep the stored password.

to.description: Recipient. Must be the acting Admin's email or the configured sender address.

TicketAssignmentView.description:
Public handling details shown to a ticket's requester. `team_name: null`
means the shared general queue; `assignee_display_name: null` means unassigned.

expertise.description: Descriptive only; only Specialist accounts may have expertise. Maximum 120 characters.

team_id.description: One current team; null removes membership. Users/Admins must use null.

email.description: Contact address; omitted keeps the current one.

oneOf.description: Interface and email language; omitted keeps the current one.

archived.description: Archiving clears leadership, memberships and assignments, retaining all history.

lead_account_id.description: Required for active teams; null when archiving. A lead must be active with team_lead role.
